description: This file defines a PHP class 'DateTimeModel' in the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. The class models a date and time in UTC, providing a method to serialize its data into an array format. It is used as part of the API schema for representing date/time information in the attendance module.

classes.name: DateTimeModel
classes.description: A PHP class representing a date and time in UTC, implementing an interface for data serialization.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DateTimeModel with a DateTime object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the DateTimeModel's internal DateTime object into an array with 'utcDate' and 'utcTime' keys.
